reason: Court held judge gave insufficient weight to Gladue and s. 718.2(e); made sentences concurrent, reducing total to six years.
Crown appeal allowed; court approved Gladue reasoning for conditional sentence but increased its length and made conditions stricter with house arrest.
Trial judge failed to give adequate weight to Aboriginal status under Gladue; sentence reduced to fifteen months plus credit.
Supreme Court found lower courts gave only attenuated Gladue consideration; Ipeelee appeal allowed and sentence reduced, Crown appeal in Ladue dismissed.
Supreme Court confirmed increased sentences, finding the trial sentences unfit; Gladue factors were weighed but did not justify a lower sentence.
